_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail: Hytale's official dedicated server (Hypixel Studios, early access since 2026-01-13; Server Manual and Server Provider Authentication Guide on support.hytale.com). The game files come with a Hytale licence (EULA §3.3: no redistribution), so the install only places the bootstrap server, HytaleServer.jar from Hytale's Maven repository (maven.hytale.com, release or pre-release patchline, latest or a version), checked against the SHA-1 published next to it. The first start runs it with --bootstrap: the owner signs in with /auth login device (their own Hytale account; 500 servers per licence) and /update download fetches Assets.zip, start.sh and Server/ with the login carried over, then the startup loop starts the real server from Server/ (Hytale's launcher layout, so /update works). Until the login is saved (Server/auth.enc), each start of the real server prints how to sign in and keep the login (/auth persistence Encrypted). Each start applies a staged update like Hytale's start.sh, and exit code 8 (update ready) starts it again. Java 25 (Hytale needs it), QUIC over UDP on the main port (--bind), the AOT cache when it's there, optional built-in backups. Nothing is accepted for the owner: signing in is their own step under Hytale's EULA and Server Operator Policies. The login files (auth.enc, auth.key) are hidden from the file manager.
name: Hytale
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Hytale is a block-based sandbox RPG from Hypixel Studios: explore, build and fight in an adventure world, with mods and minigames. Runs Hypixel's official dedicated server. Needs a Hytale account that owns the game: the install only places the bootstrap server, and on the first start the owner types /auth login device in the console, signs in at the link it prints, then types /update download; the server downloads its game files (about 3.5 GB) and starts by itself. Then /auth persistence Encrypted keeps the login across restarts.

startup_commands.Default: while :; do if [ -f Server/HytaleServer.jar ] && [ -f Assets.zip ]; then if [ -f updater/staging/Server/HytaleServer.jar ]; then echo '[Octail] Applying the staged Hytale update'; cp -f updater/staging/Server/HytaleServer.jar Server/; if [ -f updater/staging/Server/HytaleServer.aot ]; then cp -f updater/staging/Server/HytaleServer.aot Server/; fi; if [ -d updater/staging/Server/Licenses ]; then rm -rf Server/Licenses; cp -r updater/staging/Server/Licenses Server/; fi; if [ -f updater/staging/Assets.zip ]; then cp -f updater/staging/Assets.zip ./; fi; if [ -f updater/staging/start.sh ]; then cp -f updater/staging/start.sh ./; fi; rm -rf updater/staging; fi; cd Server; if [ ! -f auth.enc ]; then echo '[Octail] No saved Hytale login yet: if the console says No server tokens configured, type /auth login device and sign in, then type /auth persistence Encrypted so the login survives restarts.'; fi; aot=; if [ -f HytaleServer.aot ]; then aot=-XX:AOTCache=HytaleServer.aot; fi; backup=; if [ "{{BACKUP_FREQUENCY}}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then backup="--backup --backup-dir backups --backup-frequency {{BACKUP_FREQUENCY}} --backup-max-count {{BACKUP_MAX_COUNT}}"; fi; java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 $aot -jar HytaleServer.jar --assets ../Assets.zip --bind 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} $backup {{EXTRA_ARGS}}; code=$?; cd ..; if [ $code -eq 8 ]; then echo '[Octail] Restarting Hytale to apply the update'; continue; fi; exit $code; elif [ -f HytaleServer.jar ]; then echo '[Octail] First start, Hytale needs your account: 1) type /auth login device, open the link it prints and sign in with a Hytale account that owns the game, 2) type /update download. The server downloads its files (about 3.5 GB) and starts by itself. Then type /auth persistence Encrypted so the login survives restarts.'; java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -jar HytaleServer.jar --bootstrap; code=$?; if [ -f Server/HytaleServer.jar ] && [ -f Assets.zip ]; then continue; fi; exit $code; else echo 'Hytale is not installed (no HytaleServer.jar): reinstall the server (Settings, Reinstall).'; exit 1; fi; done

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Hytale installation (Octail's own install script). Hypixel Studios publishes no anonymous download of the game
# files: Assets.zip and the server payload come with a Hytale licence. So the install only places the bootstrap
# server, HytaleServer.jar from Hytale's own Maven repository (maven.hytale.com, latest or a version of the release or
# pre-release patchline), checked against the SHA-1 the repository publishes next to it. On the first start the
# owner signs in with their Hytale account in the console (/auth login device) and the server downloads the rest
# itself (/update download): Assets.zip, start.sh and the Server/ folder, with the login carried over.
# A server that is already set up (Server/HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip) is left alone on reinstall: it updates
# itself (/update), and worlds, mods, config.json and the login stay.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
	echo "Installation failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 120 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 "$@"; }

PATCHLINE="${HYTALE_PATCHLINE:-release}"
VERSION="${HYTALE_VERSION:-latest}"
case "${PATCHLINE}" in
	release | pre-release) ;;
	*) fail "the patchline (${PATCHLINE}) must be release or pre-release" ;;
esac
echo "${VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^(latest|[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z._-]{0,63})$' ||
	fail "the server version (${VERSION}) must be latest or a version such as 0.7.0"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ -f Server/HytaleServer.jar ] && [ -f Assets.zip ]; then
	echo "Hytale is already set up (Server/HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip): nothing to download."
	echo "It updates itself: /update check and /update download in the console, then restart."
	echo "Worlds, mods, Server/config.json and the login are untouched."
	exit 0
fi

REPO="https://maven.hytale.com/${PATCHLINE}/com/hypixel/hytale/Server"
if [ "${VERSION}" = latest ]; then
	META=$(get "${REPO}/maven-metadata.xml") || fail "Hytale's Maven repository didn't list the ${PATCHLINE} versions"
	VERSION=$(printf '%s\n' "${META}" | sed -n 's:.*<release>\([^<]*\)</release>.*:\1:p' | head -n 1)
	echo "${VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z._-]{0,63}$' ||
		fail "Hytale's Maven repository names no ${PATCHLINE} release"
fi
SHA1=$(get "${REPO}/${VERSION}/Server-${VERSION}.jar.sha1" | awk '{print tolower($1); exit}') ||
	fail "Hytale server ${VERSION} isn't on the ${PATCHLINE} patchline (the repository keeps the last five versions)"
echo "${SHA1}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' || fail "Hytale's Maven repository lists no SHA-1 for server ${VERSION}"

# Downloads are staged on the server disk: the install container's /tmp is a small tmpfs.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.octail-install
trap 'rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install' EXIT
echo "Downloading the Hytale server ${VERSION} (${PATCHLINE}) from ${REPO}"
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 1800 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors \
	-o .octail-install/HytaleServer.jar "${REPO}/${VERSION}/Server-${VERSION}.jar" ||
	fail "the download of the Hytale server ${VERSION} failed"
if ! echo "${SHA1}  .octail-install/HytaleServer.jar" | sha1sum -c --quiet -; then
	fail "HytaleServer.jar ${VERSION} doesn't match its SHA-1 (${SHA1})"
fi
mv -f .octail-install/HytaleServer.jar HytaleServer.jar
if [ ! -f HytaleServer.jar ]; then
	fail "HytaleServer.jar is missing"
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Hytale server ${VERSION} installed (SHA-1 ${SHA1} checked)."
echo "Next: start the server, type /auth login device in the console, open the link it prints and sign in with a"
echo "Hytale account that owns the game, then type /update download. The server downloads its files (about 3.5 GB)"
echo "and starts by itself."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Patchline
variables.description: release, or pre-release for Hytale's test builds. Applied when the server is set up (a new server, or a reinstall before the first sign-in); afterwards switch with /update patchline in the console.

variables.name: Server version
variables.description: latest, or one of the last five versions on the patchline, such as 0.7.0. Only picks the bootstrap server; the first /update download fetches the newest files anyway.

variables.name: Backup interval
variables.description: Minutes between Hytale's own world backups (into Server/backups), 0 for none. Octail's backups work either way.

variables.name: Backups kept
variables.description: How many of Hytale's own backups to keep when the backup interval is on.

variables.name: Extra server options
variables.description: More options for HytaleServer.jar, such as --disable-sentry (no crash reports to Hypixel), or --ignore-broken-mods.
